concept_name: Effort and struggle involved in staying organized
concept_definition: How the participant characterizes the effort required to stay organized: whether organization comes naturally or effortlessly, is maintained through manageable conscious effort or practice, requires an ongoing struggle against their disposition or a condition, or is simply not pursued with any meaningful compensatory effort. concept_name: Expressed industriousness and work drive within the organizational account
concept_definition: Whether and how the participant conveys exertion, drive, or diligence in their actual work or school tasks, as opposed to merely describing order, tools, or schedules.
